Variants.Content: Entry King Maegor I was known for his brutality, centralization of power, and ruthless suppression of resistance. He expanded the Red Castle and strengthened the royal power, but he had a head-on conflict with the Church of the Seven Gods and its armed forces; in his era, royal power, marriage, faith and force were entangled with each other. Nobles of later generations The dungeons of the Red Keep, Maegor's Tower, and the church's long-term wariness of the royal power all bear the shadow of this history.
